title: RARE: Redundancy-Aware Retrieval Evaluation Framework for High-Similarity Corpora
why_relevant: Introduces a redundancy-aware RAG retrieval evaluation framework and benchmark (RedQA) exposing robustness gaps in retrievers on enterprise corpora with high inter-document similarity.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on evaluation methodology for redundancy rather than directly on noise/conflict/adversarial robustness.
